caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a light brown color, featuring a high back with two horizontal slats, the upper one being a solid plank and the lower one consisting of two turned, decorative rods. The chair has four straight legs and a square seat that appears to be made of a slightly different, darker material, possibly a cushion or painted wood. The armrests are also wooden and have a gentle upward curve, connecting to the back and the front legs. There are additional horizontal support bars connecting the legs on each side of the chair, providing structural stability. The background is plain and light-colored, and the entire chair is centered within a faint rectangular outline on the paper.
title: Child's High Chair
